title: aphyllon cooperi subsp. palmeri
intro: Aphyllon cooperi subsp. palmeri, commonly known as Palmer's aphyllon, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Palmer's aphyllon include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
